live_release_review.result_source: controlled external result generated after vault/current-state.md

blockers.title: Production environment evidence requires a final-head rerun
blockers.evidence: Historical external evidence is retained for audit only and cannot prove the current release head.
blockers.close_condition: Fresh controlled external production environment evidence passes on the final release head.

blockers.title: Production LLM connectivity requires a final-head rerun
blockers.evidence: Historical connectivity evidence is retained for audit only and cannot prove the current release head.
blockers.close_condition: Fresh redacted production LLM connectivity evidence passes on the final release head.

blockers.title: Design handoff must be verified from controlled sources
blockers.evidence: No historical design result is allowed to close the current release gate.
blockers.close_condition: Controlled Figma, Canva, Brand Kit, design-token, flow, owner, review-date, and zero-open-issue evidence passes.

blockers.title: OTA credential rotation and backup safety require current evidence
blockers.evidence: Historical scans and attestations cannot prove the current credential or backup state.
blockers.close_condition: Fresh accountable, redacted, hash-bound Ctrip and Meituan rotation evidence passes.

blockers.title: Formal security scan requires current final-head evidence
blockers.evidence: A scan bound to another commit or outside the evidence window is historical only.
blockers.close_condition: A fresh repository-wide formal scan bound to the final release commit passes.

blockers.title: Final PR, worktree, lock, checks, and HEAD alignment require live verification
blockers.evidence: Transient branch, HEAD, worktree count, index-lock state, and PR identity are intentionally absent from tracked policy.
blockers.acceptance_command: npm run review:release-pr-candidates; npm run review:release-staged-scope; npm run review:release-external-state
blockers.close_condition: Fresh evidence proves a clean final checkout, absent .git/index.lock, selected open green PR, and exact local HEAD equals PR head.
